title: Getting Ready for World Cup Night 🔥⚽
script: The alarm goes off three hours before kickoff. Already wide awake. Jersey on, face painted, snacks ready. This isn't just a game — this is a religion. You check the lineup twice. You text the group chat. You light the candle. Everything is ritual. The world Cup only comes around every four years. Tonight, nothing else exists.
prompt_for_hailuo: Young woman with long wavy blonde hair, wearing a white national team jersey with number 10, applying face paint in mirror with excitement [Static medium shot, bright vanity lighting]. She holds up a national flag and wraps it around her shoulders like a cape [Tracking shot following her dramatic movement]. She fist-pumps the air alone in her room [Push in on her excited face, eyes bright]. Second clip: she films herself dancing with a vuvuzela and oversized sunglasses, laughing [Wide shot showing her playful pre-game setup in bedroom]. String lights and team posters visible in background, cozy pre-game energy, cinematic warm tones, 9:16 portrait.
